                )

                    print(f"     * Missing rate varies from {missing_by_group.min():.1f}% to {missing_by_group.max():.1f}%")

    if date_cols:

        for date_col in date_cols[:2]:  # Limit to first 2

    # Check for response pattern bias

    # Identify Likert-scale or rating columns
    rating_cols = [col for col in df.columns if any(keyword in col.lower()

    if rating_cols:
